records.text: Candace Owens proposed that Turning Point USA name a price to release her from the contract and said she would start a GoFundMe to raise it overnight.

appearances.snippet: Name your price, ... Turning Point USA. ... I want to know the number because I'm going to go online, ... start a GoFundMe and raise it overnight.

verification.notes: The public episode transcript directly records Owens telling TPUSA to name a price and saying she would start a GoFundMe and raise the amount overnight. This verifies the proposal and stated intention, not later fulfillment.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 2107-2185s reviewed. The primary GoFundMe page confirms the Purge Fallout Fund and says seven January 12 former employees received no severance or accrued-PTO payout. That supports the core lack-of-transition-support claim, but it does not specifically establish that every fired employee received no bonus or no other support of any kind, so the compound statement is mixed.
